description: A battalion executive officer must publish the sequence and work windows for the annual equipment inventory of two companies, set the issue freezes needed during each count, and assign the required coordination actions.

shared_context.S1: The battalion must complete its annual equipment inventory for Company A and Company B this week.
shared_context.S2: One central inventory team is available, so the companies cannot be counted at the same time.
shared_context.S3: The inventory team normally works from 0800 to 1200, and a company must pause equipment issue activity during its count.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Patel publishes the final inventory sequence and issue-control instructions.
shared_context.S5: The scheduled 0800 property-management roll call includes each company commander's standard company-status update before Maj. Patel publishes the inventory board.

PF1.text: Company A has a signed equipment handover to a replacement unit on Thursday at 1500, so its inventory must be completed on Wednesday from 0800 to 1200 and its issue activity must be frozen during that window; Capt. Morris received the signed handover notice this morning, but the battalion property calendar has not been updated.

PF2.text: Company B's only secure equipment cage is reserved for a facilities inspection on Tuesday afternoon, so the inventory team can access Company B on Monday but not during Tuesday afternoon; Capt. Okafor confirmed the reservation with facilities yesterday, but it has not yet been entered on the shared access board.

acceptance_conditions: Company B must be scheduled first because its secure cage is unavailable Tuesday afternoon.
Company A must be scheduled second on Wednesday from 0800 to 1200 because of its Thursday handover.
Both companies must have equipment issue activity frozen during their inventory windows.
The access-board reservation for Company B must be recorded.
The property-calendar handover for Company A must be recorded.
The handover timing must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: The Thursday 1500 handover changes Company A's inventory window to exactly Wednesday 0800-1200 and requires the battalion property calendar to be updated.
The Tuesday-afternoon cage reservation makes Monday 0800-1200 the required Company B count window and requires the shared access board to be updated.
